metadata.method: 2D Gaussian KDE (scipy.stats.gaussian_kde, Scott's rule bandwidth), local equirectangular projection, evaluated on an 800m grid, clipped to real Pahang district polygons
metadata.source: data/crash_points.geojson -- verified real crash coordinates only (see that file's own metadata for the verification)
metadata.disclaimer: This is a density model of WHERE past recorded crashes cluster, not a prediction of future crashes or of severity/cause -- the dataset's outcome and factor columns are independently shuffled (see README), so nothing about WHY a crash happened is used here, only verified real locations.
